cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my name in red like yours. Apology heading. Your email needs to mention the broken vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I marked a spelling error. It says 'sorry.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Spelling first. For all I know, you're sorry about the font. Put the vase in the subject.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase' to Mum. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I broke it.' My name comes out before your apology goes in.
